svg.title: Three signals from one VM, and where each goes
svg.desc: vm-monitor's platform CPU metric feeds alert-vm-cpu-high (average over 80% for 5 minutes); the Azure Monitor agent sends counters and syslog through dcr-vm-linux into log-lab, capped at 0.05 GB a day; a restart written to the activity log fires alert-vm-restart. Both alerts go to ag-lab, which has no receivers, so nobody is notified.
